title: Broad-Persistent Advising in Interactive Reinforcement Learning via Latent State Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.13712v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep Interactive Reinforcement Learning (Deep IntRL) accelerates reinforcement learning training by incorporating external advice. However, conventional Deep IntRL uses each piece of advice only in the current step and discards it after a single interaction. Persistent Advising and Broad-Persistent Advising (BPA) extend this process by storing advice in persistent memory and reusing it in similar states through state generalisation based on K-means clustering. This research proposes Encoder BPA, which employs a latent encoder to retrieve and reuse advice. In this framework, a trained encoder is used to map a state sequence into a latent representation at every time step. Advice can be retrieved through latent comparison, together with a top-(k) aggregation and a consistency condition to improve reuse stability. translated_title: 基于潜在状态编码的交互式强化学习中的广泛持久性建议方法
translated_abstract: 深度交互式强化学习（Deep IntRL）通过引入外部建议来加速强化学习的训练。然而，传统的深度交互式强化学习仅在当前步骤使用每条建议，并在单次交互后将其丢弃。持久建议和广泛持久建议通过将建议存储在持久内存中，并基于K-means聚类的状态泛化在相似状态中重用建议，从而扩展了这一过程。本研究提出了Encoder BPA，该方法采用潜在编码器来检索和重用建议。在该框架中，使用训练好的编码器在每个时间步将状态序列映射为潜在表示。建议可以通过潜在比较进行检索，同时结合top-k聚合和一致性条件以提高重用的稳定性。实验结果表明，Encoder BPA在训练早期阶段提高了学习效率和建议利用率。
tldr: 本文提出Encoder BPA方法，用潜在状态编码器替代传统K-means聚类，通过潜在比较、top-k聚合和一致性条件来检索和重用外部建议，从而提升了交互式强化学习早期的学习效率和建议利用率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Encoder BPA, which replaces K-means clustering with a latent state encoder to retrieve and reuse advice through latent comparison, top-k aggregation, and a consistency condition, improving early-stage learning efficiency and advice utilization in interactive reinforcement learning.
